# INC-2013-03-03: Edge routers failed across the network

Source: https://blog.cloudflare.com/todays-outage-post-mortem-82515/

Lines starting with ">" are quoted from that page.

> a system-wide failure of our edge routers

The last global outage before 2 July 2019. The time of day is not recorded here.
